v1_human_g3_constraints.c_1: The sum of all required resources must not exceed overall capacity.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_2: A resource must not reference a resource that is not defined.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_3: All resources are overallocated together and must be satisfied.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_5: Each request must be prepared as or did, mapping resource to numeric ammount.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_6: If any request is not a dictionary, the function must return a value error.

v1_human_g3_exception: No partial acceptance at requests. No prioritization. All requests are evaluated simultaneously.

v1_human_g3_frs.fr_1: The function shall determine whether the total amount required for each resource does not exceed its available capacity.
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_2: The function shall return false if any request violates a resource list is not available.
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_3: The function shall validate that each request is a dictionary.
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_4: The function shall return true if allocatable is feasible.

v1_human_g3_goal: The objective of the system is to determine whether a set of resource requests can be met given a fixed amount of resources.
v1_human_g3_input: Resources represent total capacity per resource. Requests represents individual resource amounts. Resources: is a dictionary mapping type data strings and integers. Requests: is a list where each element is a resource request. Each element is dictionary.

v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_1: Resource usage will never exceed capacity.

v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_1: The function must not allocate or accept requests for undefined resources.
v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_2: The function must not strictly accept malformed requests.

v1_human_g3_output: The function returns a boolean value based on whether all resources can be allocated.
v1_human_g3_tie_breaking: All feasible scenarios are verified equally within a prioritized manner.
